title: Constraint: Eight Queens
constraints: Place 8 queens on a chessboard, one per row (`col[r]` = column of the queen in row r), so that no two share a column or a diagonal. Different calls should find different solutions (92 exist).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: One queen per row is built into the representation. You only need columns and diagonals.
Two queens in rows i < j are on a diagonal when `|col[i] − col[j]| == j − i`. Write it as two inequalities with signed (`int'`) arithmetic.
Unsigned subtraction wraps: cast to `int` before subtracting.
